levels: One-shots peak-normalized to -1 dBFS (decoded) and trimmed to start at the transient; loops ~-20 LUFS integrated (ciws_servo -24) and seamless (sample-exact wrap). ciws_spinup / ciws_fire_loop / ciws_tail share one gain so they splice.

ciws_fire_loop.desc: Close (~20 m) CIWS firing at 4,528 rpm: 226 rounds at an exact 636-sample period, seamless 2.995 s loop. Play ciws_spinup, start this loop exactly at spinup end, stop it and start ciws_tail at the same instant.
ciws_fire_loop.source: bainbridge.webm (USS Bainbridge CIWS PACFIRE, US Navy, PD): real per-shot grains; synthesized gas/thump/mechanism/motor layers

ciws_spinup.desc: Gun drive wind-up (0.14 s) plus the first rounds accelerating to full rate. Ends exactly one shot period after its last round, so ciws_fire_loop starts at the end of this buffer. Same gain as the loop.
ciws_spinup.source: bainbridge.webm (USS Bainbridge CIWS PACFIRE, US Navy, PD): real per-shot grains; synthesized gas/thump/mechanism/motor layers

ciws_tail.desc: End of burst: decelerating last rounds, drive spin-down and brake clack, then ~2.5 s of rolling outdoor echo (real Navy recording + synthetic diffuse reverb). Same gain as the loop.
ciws_tail.source: bainbridge.webm (USS Bainbridge CIWS PACFIRE, US Navy, PD): real per-shot grains; synthesized gas/thump/mechanism/motor layers; usn_ciws.webm (US Navy CIWS System firing, PD): real outdoor echo tail after a burst

ciws_distant_loop.desc: The same burst heard from 1-3 km: top end gone, 75 Hz 'BRRRT' growl and low harmonics, sea-surface reflection, diffuse echo; 2.995 s seamless loop, phase-compatible with ciws_fire_loop.
ciws_distant_loop.source: bainbridge.webm (USS Bainbridge CIWS PACFIRE, US Navy, PD): real per-shot grains; synthesized gas/thump/mechanism/motor layers

ciws_servo.desc: (extra) Mount slew servo/hydraulic whine, 1.0 s loop; drive gain and playbackRate (0.8-1.3) from slew rate.

gun_5in.desc: Close 5-inch round (~20-60 m): sharp report, pressure thump, reverb tail over the water, ~3.3 s (one firing cycle at 18-20 rds/min).
gun_5in.source: dvids_937504.mp4 / dvids_836211.mp4 (USS Dewey Mk 45 firing, US Navy, PD) + synthesized shock/thump/sub, case-ejection clatter, synthetic over-water IR

gun_5in_distant.desc: 5-inch gun heard at 5-20 km: soft-edged deep boom, rolling low tail, nothing above ~1 kHz.

vls_launch.desc: Close VLS launch heard from the bridge wing: ignition blast + uptake exhaust vent, roaring motor rising past, then receding and dropping in pitch as the missile climbs away; stereo, ~8.5 s. Starts at ignition (t=0).
vls_launch.source: austin_sm2.webm / porter_sm2.webm (SM-2 launches, USS Oscar Austin / USS Porter, US Navy, PD), Freesound 515123 (rocket thrust, CC0), synthesized ignition blast, uptake vent, motor roar/crackle; physically rendered climb-out (doppler, 1/r, air absorption, sea reflection)

vls_launch_distant.desc: A VLS launch from another ship ~4 km away: dull boom, then a distant low roar that swells and fades as the missile climbs; stereo, ~9 s.
vls_launch_distant.source: synth motor + Freesound 515123 (CC0), rendered at ~4 km

rocket_motor_loop.desc: Close rocket-motor roar with shock crackle for missiles in flight; 4 s seamless loop. Engine applies distance/doppler.

jet_asm_loop.desc: Small turbojet of a subsonic sea-skimming cruise missile: high compressor whine, buzz and jet roar; 3 s seamless loop.
jet_asm_loop.source: synth (turbine tones, jet mixing noise) + Freesound 477132 (jet engine, CC0) pitched up

ramjet_loop.desc: Harsh supersonic ramjet: tearing broadband roar, combustion buzz, crackle; 3 s seamless loop.
ramjet_loop.source: synth (roar, 141 Hz combustion buzz, tearing HF, crackle) + Freesound 515122 (CC0)

missile_flyby.desc: Pre-rendered close pass of a missile (1: subsonic turbojet sea-skimmer at 285 m/s, 22 m abeam; 2: rocket-powered missile at 310 m/s, 35 m): doppler whoosh-roar with sea-reflection phasing, stereo left->right, 3.6 s, closest approach heard at 1.5 s. Play without engine doppler (it is baked in).
missile_flyby.source: jet_asm_loop / synth rocket motor + Freesound 515123 (CC0), physically rendered pass

sonic_boom.desc: Supersonic missile passing: sharp N-wave double crack (bow/tail shocks) followed by the sea-reflected N-wave ~30 ms later, short rumbling tail; ~1.5 s.

chaff_launch.desc: Decoy launcher firing a chaff/decoy round: hollow mortar thump, whoosh of the round leaving and receding, faint burst pop ~2 s later; ~3 s.
chaff_launch.source: synth (mortar blast, tube resonance, rocket whoosh, burst pop) + Freesound 187767 (CC0)

explosion_ship_hit.desc: Anti-ship missile warhead hitting our own ship: penetration crunch, huge detonation, hull ringing, tearing plates, debris raining on deck, secondary cook-offs and fireball; ~9 s.

splash_small.desc: A round or fragment hitting the water: sharp entry 'tsip', small spout, droplets; ~1 s.

debris_metal.desc: Fragments/debris hitting steel deck and superstructure: clang, bounces, small rattle; ~2 s.

explosion_near.desc: Warhead detonation 100-500 m away: crack, fireball body, fragments whizzing and splashing, rolling tail; ~5-6 s.
explosion_near.source: Freesound 235968 / 262436 (CC0) real explosions + synth blast, fragment whizz, fragments splashing into the sea, rolling tail, synthetic outdoor IR

explosion_far.desc: Explosion 5-20 km away: deep dull boom, low rolling rumble, no high end; ~7 s.
explosion_far.source: Freesound 320788 (Kostrava, distant explosions, CC0) + synth sub boom/rolling tail

explosion_air.desc: Proximity-fuzed airburst of an interceptor warhead a few hundred m up: very sharp crack, then rolling thunder-like echo; ~6-7 s.
explosion_air.source: synth crack/body/rolling tail + Freesound 194364 (thunder, Dave Welsh, CC0)

splash_big.desc: A missile or large piece of wreckage slamming into the sea: heavy slap/thump, water sheet and spray, column collapsing back as a downpour; ~4 s.
splash_big.source: Freesound 442773, 316744, 529794 (CC0) splashes + synth impact thump, bubbles, fall-back

metal_groan.desc: Deep structural groan/creak of a stressed, sinking hull; ~7 s, soft attack (ambient one-shot).
metal_groan.source: Freesound 675486, 496836, 556714 (CC0) pitched down + synth hull resonances

ocean_loop.desc: Open-ocean waves heard from the deck: irregular swell wash, whitecap hiss, low swell rumble, a little slap against the hull; stereo 40 s seamless loop.
ocean_loop.source: synth open-sea wave wash + Freesound 551436 (waves against a ship's bow), 167684 (wind, low-passed) (CC0)

hull_wash_loop.desc: Water rushing along a steel hull at 15-20 kt heard from the deck edge: continuous wash, gurgle and slap, low rush; stereo 30 s seamless loop.
hull_wash_loop.source: Freesound 360631 (bow wave, close), 570927 (metal barge bow) (CC0) + synth low rush

wind_loop.desc: Strong sea wind on deck: gusting body, rigging/antenna whistles following the gusts, low buffeting; stereo 30 s seamless loop.

ship_engine_loop.desc: Warship machinery heard on deck: gas turbine intake/uptake roar and compressor whine, ventilation fans, electrical hum, drone through the deck; stereo 30 s seamless loop.
ship_engine_loop.source: synth gas-turbine roar/whine, vent fans, 60 Hz hum, hull ticks + Freesound 398851, 74915 (ferry below-deck / engine room, CC0) low-passed

fire_loop.desc: Large fire burning on deck: roaring flames, hiss, crackle and pops, low breathing roar; stereo 30 s seamless loop.
fire_loop.source: Freesound 698209 (large fire roar), 563765 (car fire), 181562 (crackling) (CC0) + synth low roar

alarm_gq.desc: General Quarters alarm: the rapid repeating electro-mechanical 'bong-bong-bong' gong through the 1MC shipboard loudspeakers (horn band-limit, overdrive, slap echoes, steel reverb); stereo, ~6 s.
alarm_gq.source: synth (inharmonic gong partials, 1MC loudspeaker chain, ship reverb)

alarm_klaxon.desc: 'Brace for impact' / collision alarm: urgent rapid high buzzer pulses over the 1MC; stereo, ~3 s.
alarm_klaxon.source: synth (pulsed harsh two-tone buzzer, 1MC loudspeaker chain)

ui_click.desc: Console button click (switch press + release), 60 ms.

ui_track_new.desc: New radar track: soft two-note rising sonar-like blip, ~0.4 s.

ui_alert.desc: VAMPIRE / inbound missile alert: three urgent bright beeps with a harsh edge, ~0.7 s (retrigger to repeat).

ui_kill.desc: Confirmed kill: quick bright ascending three-note chirp, ~0.45 s.

ui_warn.desc: Caution/warning: two low alternating tones (down-step), ~0.55 s.
